name: the chat reply lands as a live change in the page
looks: A short reply appears beside a live page preview, and the exact moment it lands, the preview's own headline swaps to new, more specific copy right there in the layout -- no cursor, no click, the page simply updates itself a beat behind the conversation.
build: Two fixed panels, chat narrower than the preview; the chat's reply line triggers one content swap in the preview (a clip-path text reveal) cued to that reply's landing time, inside the preview's existing layout bounds so nothing reflows.
sound: A soft low pad under the chat, a light chime exactly as the preview's headline changes.
prompt: Sit a short exchange beside a live document or page preview, and let the preview's own headline update itself the instant the reply lands, with no cursor or click shown -- the change should read as the conversation directly writing into the finished page, one beat behind.
